subject.title: fix(codex): continue after source-reply delivery instead of terminating turn

question: After real Discord/Codex proof is supplied, should this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/107388 be the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/106961?
rationale: Both branches implement substantially the same runtime rule, neither currently has sufficient real behavior proof, and only maintainers should choose which contributor branch owns the final runtime, schema-guidance, and regression coverage.

options.title: Canonicalize this PR
options.body: Use this branch as the landing candidate because it preserves recovery telemetry and has broader focused runtime coverage, incorporating any uniquely useful schema wording from the sibling before merge.

options.title: Canonicalize the sibling PR
options.body: Use the sibling branch if it first supplies stronger live proof and retains this branch's recovery and edge-case coverage, then close this PR as superseded.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize this PR
recommendation.body: Use this branch as the landing candidate because it preserves recovery telemetry and has broader focused runtime coverage, incorporating any uniquely useful schema wording from the sibling before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Codex source-reply work owns the affected terminal, completion, and recovery behavior.
